items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: I was with Jack about three months and then I was drafted in the Army.

ctx.x: Was that culture shock or what?
I don’t know. It was a shock, I don’t know how much culture was involved. So that’s how I got to know Jack.
In Missouri, what kind of music did you hear as a child growing up?
